text:
sam-support: heads up — customer (Acct 8421) says rerank endpoint started returning 504/502s around 15:02 UTC during a traffic spike. p95 token latency jumped from ~120ms to ~3.2s. They also reported unexpected billing jump. Can we triage?

infra-bot: alert: rerank.p95 latency > 2s (15:01:40) - https://grafana.redwood/alerts/8231 :pagerduty #inc-4982

jon-eng: @sam-support can you paste a request_id + example payload? Also which model variant were they hitting?

sam-support: request_id: rnk-0a1b2c3d, customer supplied full payload (anonymized):
```json
{"query":"best restaurants in sf","candidates":[{"id":"a1","text":"..."}, {"id":"a2","text":"..."}], "top_k":10}
```
They were using model: rwr-rerank-v1 (default), QPS ~450 for ~30s burst.

maya-sre: paste from gateway logs for that request: 
```
[15:01:41] gateway: request rnk-0a1b2c3d -> upstream rerank-svc timed out after 2000ms, retrying (attempt=1)
[15:01:42] gateway: request rnk-0a1b2c3d -> upstream returned 502 Bad Gateway (attempt=2)
[15:01:43] rerank-svc: 5xx: kv-cache miss, OOM-ish log: alloc failed while serializing scores
[15:01:43] gateway: final for rnk-0a1b2c3d -> 504 Gateway Timeout
```

olivia-ml: kv-cache eviction + large candidate lists could blow up memory per-request. Do we know candidate sizes? top_k=10 above but customer said sometimes they send 200 candidates in a single request for re-ranking experiments.

jon-eng: that explains latency. If client sends 200 candidates we 1) do more scoring 2) KV cache grows and may cause GC/alloc stalls. Can we confirm payloads at 15:01:40? @sam-support can you forward full raw payload logs for that time?

sam-support: forwarded via DM (sensitive). Also noticed the gateway had header X-Retries: 2 and X-Client-Retry: true on several requests — looks like our retry loop may be doubling work. Customer client retries on 502 which triggers gateway retry; both counted as requests for billing.

cs-ops: that's likely why billing spiked. We bill per scoring API call/token. Retries that reach backend also generate billable tokens. Need to audit counts for Acct 8421 between 14:58-15:05 UTC.

jon-eng: quick repro attempt locally:
```bash
# simulate burst with many candidates
python tools/loadtest_rerank.py --endpoint https://api.redwood/rerank --token xxx --qps 500 --duration 30 --candidates 200
```
I'll run this against staging with controlled concurrency and capture traces.

maya-sre: suggestion: set gateway per-customer concurrency cap and slower retry backoff to avoid retry amplification. Also enable per-request memory guards in rerank-svc to return 429 early if candidate count > 100.

infra-bot: deploy-bot detected a canary rollback at 15:12 for rerank-svc -> rolled back last rollout 1.3.2 -> 1.3.1 due to p95 regressions.

olivia-ml: check whether 1.3.2 changed scoring batch algorithm or increased memory footprint (I recall we switched to fused kernels for long candidate arrays). If so, fused kernels + large candidate arrays could push memory over transient threshold.

jon-eng: plan: 1) reproduce on staging with 200-candidate bursts (me) 2) capture p95/alloc traces & flamegraphs (maya) 3) add quick guard to reject >150 candidates with 422 (olivia + jon) 4) cs-ops to audit billing and potentially credit customer for retry-amplified charges (cs-ops)

cs-ops: noted. I'll start billing audit and hold any invoices for that window until we confirm.

sam-support: I've told customer we're investigating and asked them to avoid client-side retries for now. Will update in 30m.

jon-eng: running staging load now, will attach spans. If anyone has synthetic repro script improvements ping me.

maya-sre: also attaching a quick mitigation we can flip: lower gateway upstream timeout to 1200ms for non-critical accounts and enable client-retry suppression header handling (X-Client-Retry -> don't gateway-retry). Will prepare a config change for ops-review.

olivia-ml: one more ask — export model-specific KV cache hit rates for 15:00-15:05, and memstats for rerank workers. If KV hit rate dropped severely we have a thrash pattern.

sam-support: thanks all. I'll collect customer repros and keep thread updated.

deploy-bot: scheduled config patch (gateway: retry-suppression header handling) for canary at 15:40 UTC pending ops approval.

jon-eng: marking action items: jon (repro + traces), maya (ops guard + timeout change), olivia (model/kv cache check), cs-ops (billing audit), sam (customer comms).

sam-support: closing loop — if we confirm retry amplification + large candidate arrays caused 5xx/timeouts and billing spike, propose credit + permanent guard on candidate_count + doc update. :thumbsup:
